name: orca-bots
title: Orca Bots
description: Ask Orca bots questions, read their replies, and monitor agents. Requires the Orca app.
author: eromleduk

commands.name: ask-bot
commands.title: Ask Bot
commands.description: Send a prompt to an Orca bot and read its reply

commands.name: open-agents
commands.title: Open Agents
commands.description: See what your Orca agents are doing at a glance

commands.name: ask-default-bot
commands.title: Ask Default Bot
commands.description: Send a question to your default bot and read its reply in one step

preferences.name: orcaPath
preferences.title: Orca CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the CLI bundled inside Orca.app.

preferences.name: defaultBot
preferences.title: Default Bot
preferences.description: Bot folder inside ~/.orca/bots, for example ~/.orca/bots/leglaude. Used by "Ask Default Bot".
